summary: Blaize Holdings, Inc. filed a preliminary prospectus supplement on Form 424B5 to offer shares of its common stock in an underwritten public offering. The filing is a shelf takedown under a Form S-3 shelf registration. The offering size and price are not yet determined; the May 4, 2026 closing price was $2.33 per share. Northland Capital Markets is sole book-running manager and Benchmark is co-manager. Because this is a standard equity offering without an acquisition, divestiture, or other special situation, it does not qualify as a special event.
